desc:
Steal a Brainrot Egg is a brainrot tycoon where you sneak in, steal an egg, run home and hatch it! 🥚🏃

🌍 2 WORLDS, 22 BIOMES! NEW World 2: Toy Box, Dino Valley, Sky Castle, Disco, Candy Kingdom and Crystal Caves
🐣 Hatch 170+ Brainrots like Tung Tung Tung Sahur and Brr Brr Patapim
💰 Every Brainrot in your pen earns cash every second
⚡  Train on your treadmill to outrun the bosses guarding the eggs
🥚 Steal eggs from other players' bases, set traps and protect your own
💎 NEW: break Gem Crystals and spend your Gems in the Gem Shop
🧬  Fuse 3 of the same Brainrot for a better mutation: Gold, Diamond, Rainbow, Holo, Aurora, Prism...
✨  Rare Brainrots up to Secret, OG and the new Astral and Ascended, each with its own title and aura
 🪅  Speed AND Cash Piñatas every 15 minutes
🗼 Climb the Speed Tower obby
🌙 Every 5 minutes night falls: eggs reset and new ones spawn!
🏆 Climb the leaderboards

👥 Play with friends · 📱 Mobile friendly · 🔄 New biomes added of
